title: "THE FIRST TRIES"
paragraph_01: The First Tries, were the first batch of maps I created and released around 2018, at that time I was 15 years old.
paragraph_02: Beginning around 2017 and ending late in 2018 during a time when I made these in my free time after school, I created 5 quite simple maps in the world builder for the Source Engine called "Hammer", that initially begun as curiousness and shortly fell into being fun. This was about the first time when I realized how fun I found development to be, as throughout the time I made them, I found making them more enjoyable for whatever I was doing during that time at school
paragraph_03: Unfortunately however it would take me quite some time to realize that I should have put most of my work into building a career, so for most of that time I was only curious
paragraph_04: Prior to creating these 5 maps, at which a time I saw nothing too the engine, I was making small levels with friends in Roblox based around things I played on that platform, but these were merely early attempts
